items.title: The Token Supercycle: Everything of Value is Becoming Programmable
items.whyYouShouldCare: The shift towards programmable assets could enhance Solana's ecosystem by increasing the utility and integration of its tokens across various applications.

items.title: The token supercycle: everything of value is becoming programmable
items.whyYouShouldCare: As more assets become programmable, Solana could see increased demand for its infrastructure, potentially boosting liquidity and user engagement within its network.

items.title: Pyth Network: Will PYTH’s 12% gains mark the start of a bigger rally?
items.whyYouShouldCare: If PYTH's gains continue, it may signal growing confidence in data oracles on Solana, which could attract more developers and projects to the platform.
